description: This Java class defines a custom datatype for 'Program' entities in the OpenMRS framework. It extends a base datatype class and provides deserialization logic based on UUIDs, utilizing OpenMRS services and annotations for integration.

classes.name: ProgramDatatype
classes.description: A component class that supports custom data type serialization/deserialization for the 'Program' entity within OpenMRS.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Converts a UUID string into a Program object by retrieving it via the ProgramWorkflowService; returns null if input is blank.
